claim: Inventory and selected source inspection; semantic closure and target resource acceptance remain open.

extracted/archives/bsd.next_experiment: Compare 3BSD, 4.2, 4.3, 4.3RENO and Net2 libc lineage by source hash and semantic delta; prioritize sort, numeric conversion, stdio and ABI history.

extracted/archives/att.next_experiment: Compare V7 through System V Release 4 mechanisms and shared-libc lineage; separate per-file permission evidence, public contracts and historical behavior before independent implementation.

extracted/archives/osf.next_experiment: Audit exec arithmetic, generated request checks and usercopy error ownership; identify packed OSF source containers separately from extracted files.

extracted/archives/xinu.next_experiment: Audit first-fit allocation, semaphore transitions and callback typing; distinguish Sun3/68K/SPARC assumptions from portable invariants and resolve source permissions.

extracted/collections/schily/schily-2024.next_experiment: Inspect selected members of the content-pinned 2024-03-21 release and compare Schillix libschily ancestry; inspect SFIO closure before admitting memory-stream adapters.

extracted/collections/mach.next_experiment: Compare bounded interface definitions and generated serialization; derive flat-buffer contracts without assuming Mach port or out-of-line memory services.

sources/sun/os/opensolaris/schillix/coll.next_experiment: Audit libc/libschily/libast mechanisms, per-file licenses and full dependency closure; treat process-cwd emulation as an adversarial case for native directory-relative calls.

sources/sun/os/sunos.next_experiment: Inspect SunOS source and packaged artifacts separately; compare numeric and ABI lineage with pinned BSD sources and resolve each source grant.

sources/sun/os/solaris.next_experiment: Inspect Solaris source and packaged artifacts separately; distinguish historical restricted files from later openly licensed versions and compare error/locale contracts.

archives/mach.next_experiment: Deduplicate CMU and mirror paths by selected source hash; inspect MIG and libmach callback/varargs seams and packaged-source member identities.

archives/minix.next_experiment: Reconcile package README restrictions with per-file grants and top-level license; compare NetBSD-derived utility files to the existing pinned NetBSD donor before semantic review.

archives/research.next_experiment: Bind local SUS documents to the existing standards denominator; inspect research-Unix source/media by specific ABI or algorithm question, preserving edition identities.

archives/sel4/SeL4-src.next_experiment: Prioritize seL4 ownership admission and BSD-licensed ABI generation; compare package versions and verified configuration boundaries without transferring proof claims to Cortex-M0+.
